units.en: As Iran, become the owner of former Achaemenid Empire's states

⟦0⟧ It is also possible to complete the achievements ⟦1⟧ (conquer ⟦2⟧), and ⟦3⟧ (conquer the Middle East, including Arabia, see the images below) by following this strategy guide, as they are closely related.
This strategy requires the ⟦0⟧ DLC to be ⟦1⟧.

Play on non-historical. You'll likely have to do a number of runs before you hit on a favorable faction alignment. Ideally, since you must take land from 3 majors (the ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and the ⟦2⟧), you are looking for a run where those nations end up weak. It's actually fine to set ⟦3⟧ to Historical while leaving the other two on Random if you want, since ⟦4⟧ historically takes one of its worst paths. A world with a lot of factions is also decent bet, as you can play the factions against each other to secure a peace deal that leaves you significantly stronger. In an ideal scenario, the ⟦5⟧ decolonizes, ⟦6⟧ goes historical or non-aligned, and the ⟦7⟧ has a civil war that doesn't lead into Trotsky. It's also great if the ⟦8⟧ isn't in any of the European factions but forms its own. If you can manage to join or even just keep them friendly, you will have a permanent ally whose interests never conflict with yours.

In early game, go hard for industrial expansion. Take ⟦0⟧, use the PP to switch to Partial Mobilization, continue to ⟦1⟧. Build nothing but infrastructure and civilian factories before the end of 1937. At some point take ⟦2⟧ and eventually ⟦3⟧. This puts you on course for a civil war, and you'll need to save up a lot of PP, have 12 owned factories, and have 80k manpower in the field in order to stop it.

Feel free to join the Saadabad Pact (or even to initiate it). You'll lose the benefits eventually (you'll need to conquer all three other members), but it'll be good while it lasts. Among other benefits, you'll get mountaineers researched for free when Turkey takes ⟦0⟧. Immediately start training mountaineers up to the special forces cap and advancing their doctrine (they'll be very useful in ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧).

You should have ~24 divisions in the field by the time you take ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ (they tend to accept; they are more likely to accept if you have a significantly larger army and they are under 50% war support.) At some point, you'll need to switch to Limited Conscription (possibly by taking the ⟦2⟧ focus). Switch straight to Service by Requirement as soon as the game allows (this will be when you are at war with a sufficiently large enemy) - manpower is your major handicap; until you gain some new cores, you can't field much more than ~30 divisions in with Limited Conscription, you are not allowed to switch to higher conscription laws in peacetime because you're non-aligned, and you have to stay non-aligned to be eligible for this branch of the focus tree. Build a supply depot in the northernmost province of West Azerbaijan (the one adjacent to Van and Yerevan) and another in the easternmost province of Herat.

The subsequent events will vary from game to game, depending on factions and guarantees. Your short-term objective is to conquer ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧. Iraq is the easiest of three (especially once you force them to cede 2 out of their 5 states), but it tends to stay guaranteed by the ⟦3⟧. Afghanistan has a relatively small army, but it gets insane defense benefits from its mountains and rivers and may prove to be a tough nut to crack. Don't even think of going there unless you have a supply depot, mountaineers, and twice their manpower (and even then it won't be a cakewalk.) Turkey tends to have an army that is comparable to yours ⟦4⟧ you have to fight through several mountain provinces to reach their heartland. It starts guaranteed by Romania and it often gets guaranteed by the ⟦5⟧ after 1939. Watch for these guarantees and pounce if you see anyone who's not guaranteed, or if you see e.g. ⟦6⟧ guaranteeing ⟦7⟧ (in which case, if you have the army to fight on two fronts, you can deal with Turkey without any of its guarantors.)
Sometimes the ⟦0⟧ also decides to guarantee ⟦1⟧, which is a carte blanche to attack ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ (if both of you are guaranteed, the UK won't intervene).
In the mean time, complete focuses ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧.

⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ allow you to core all ⟦2⟧ states of ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ respectively, at 75pp per state. (NOTE: The four Turkish states in the southeast - Hakkari, Van, Diyarbakir, and Tunceli - do ⟦5⟧ start the game as Turkish cores, and will be ineligible for this focus unless Turkey reintegrates them first. The others will be eligible for integration once you take them in peace conference.)
⟦0⟧ allows you to core all ⟦1⟧ states in the Middle East (including the entire Arabian Peninsula) or in ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ for Turkish cores, likewise at 75pp per state.
Coring all eligible states potentially makes Iran into a global superpower with a core population of 80M+ and the ability to go toe to toe with other majors.

Additionally, if ⟦0⟧ is first created as a collaboration government, given the necessary states to form ⟦1⟧ and then allowed to control and core North Africa and ⟦2⟧, then it will be possible to core those regions with ⟦3⟧ once ⟦4⟧ is annexed.
It's also possible to core ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ via ⟦2⟧, but it is a fairly long-winded and unintuitive process;
1: Declare war on and puppet ⟦0⟧. Do not join or get into a war with any factions until after step 4, and after ⟦1⟧ finishes the ⟦2⟧ focus.
2: Improve relations with ⟦0⟧, finish ⟦1⟧ and hope they hand over the border states.
3: Release ⟦0⟧ as an independent country from the states the ⟦1⟧ just gave you (make sure to retain your core in Sistan).

4: Immediately justify and declare war on ⟦0⟧. Call ⟦1⟧ into the war. It's important not to be involved in any faction wars at this point, as ⟦2⟧ may join an enemy faction. In the peace deal, give North Baluchistan to ⟦3⟧, and take the coastal state for yourself.

Now ⟦0⟧ will, eventually, core ⟦1⟧ with the ⟦2⟧ focus. It will take a while, as the AI will not prioritize it. This is why you shouldn't give them a coast, as they might get distracted doing useless naval focuses. Make sure not to finish ⟦3⟧ until after the Confederation is formed, as it won't apply the cores retroactively.
…and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton!
